questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ yàoshi xiǎng tīng gùshide huà, wǒ gěi ni jiǎng yíge ya!

answers.answer_text: If you want to listen to a story, I'll tell you one.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Suàn le. Wǒmen xià qí ba!

answers.answer_text: Forget it. Let's play chess.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō jiěfàng yǐhòu, Gòngchǎndǎng zuòle xiē hǎo shì.

answers.answer_text: I've heard that the Communist Party did some good things after liberation.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Èng, yǒu xiē zhèngcè shi bú cuò, yǒu xiē bú tài hǎo.

answers.answer_text: Yes, some policies were all right, but some weren't too good.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lǎo Wángde érzi rùguo Tuán ma?

answers.answer_text: Did Lǎo Wáng's son ever join the Communist Youth League?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Méiyou, tīngshuō cānjiāguo Hóngwèibīng.

answers.answer_text: No, but I've heard that he was in the Red Guards.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ tīngshuō le ma, Lǎo Zhāngde nǚér àishang Xiǎo Wáng le.

answers.answer_text: Have you heard? Lǎo Zhāng's daughter has fallen in love with Xiǎo Wáng.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhè zhēn shi máfan shìr, Lǎo Zhāng zuì hèn Wángjiāde rén.

answers.answer_text: This is really trouble. Lǎo Zhāng really hates the Wáng family.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Rúguǒ nǐ bù jièyìde huà, wǒ xiǎng hé nǐde mìshu tán jǐfēn zhōng.

answers.answer_text: If you don't mind, I'd like to talk with your secretary for a few minutes.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā zài dǎ zì, mǎshàng jiù lái.

answers.answer_text: He's typing, he'll be here in a moment.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèige háizi bù xiàng huà, bù guǎn zěnme shuō dōu bù tīng.

answers.answer_text: This child is too much. No matter what you say, he just doesn't listen.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duì ma, zhè nǎr xiàng Xīn Zhōngguóde értóng!

answers.answer_text: Yes, he's certainly no [not like any] child of "New China."

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèipiān duǎnpiān xiǎoshuō xiěde shi shénme?

answers.answer_text: What is this short story about?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiěde shi yíge nóngcūn gànbude gùshi.

answers.answer_text: It's the story of a cadre in a rural area.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ jíjímángmángde, zuò shénme qu a?

answers.answer_text: What are you in such a hurry to go do?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shàng xué qu a!

answers.answer_text: I'm going to school!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèngfǔ shì bu shì bǎohù rénmende cáichǎn?

answers.answer_text: Does the government protect people's property?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì. Zhèngfǔ shíxíng bǎohù rénmen cáichǎnde zhèngcè.

answers.answer_text: Yes. The government is carrying out a policy of protecting people's property.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài Gòngchǎndǎng lǐngdǎoxia, Zhōngguó zài shìjièshangde dìwèi yǒule hěn dàde gǎibiàn.

answers.answer_text: Under the leadership of the Communist Party, China's position in the world has changed greatly.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shínián lái, zhèi liǎngge chéngshìde gōngshāngyè yuè lái yuè fādá le.

answers.answer_text: In the past ten years industry and commerce in these two cities have become more and more developed.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhè hé zhèngfǔde lǐngdǎo shi fēnbukāide.

answers.answer_text: This can't be separated from the government's leadership.
